jobs.occupation: 3 periodic office cleaners - full-time - Waregem-Zulte region - starting at 6:00 AM
jobs.description:
• Periodic office/building cleaner in the Waregem-Zulte region
• Periodic maintenance of sanitary facilities, cafeteria, and dressing rooms
• Multiple clients throughout the day

• You are driven and have a strong work ethic.
• You have a driver's license (B category) and you can and dare to drive with gears.
• You are flexible and eager to learn.
• You speak Dutch and/or English.
• Working in a team is a must.
• You take responsibility for your workplace and maintain order for your equipment and company vehicle.
• You can start at 6:00 AM.
• You live in the Waregem-Zulte region.
• You have a means of transport to get to Comfort Cleaning and leave from there.
